title: FastAPI + Redis
goal: Build production-style REST APIs with authentication, databases, caching, and queues.

project.name: URL Shortener API
project.prd: A FastAPI service that shortens URLs, tracks clicks, and caches lookups in Redis with JWT auth.
project.architecture: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL for storage, Redis for caching and rate limiting, Celery for async.
tasks: Define scope
Build core features
Test and document
Ship and push to GitHub
